checks.bounded_acceptance_runner: pass; default tools/run_acceptance.py runs the first-contact smoke suite in fresh interpreters; --all-modules expands to the full module list, and --shard N/M keeps long audits inside short execution windows
checks.sqlite_close_cleanup: pass; close-time WAL cleanup uses bounded passive checkpointing rather than truncating checkpointing
checks.scenario_template_gate: pass; generated capsule placeholders raise scenario-capsule-template-not-edited before run creation, including a lightweight default guard test
checks.license: pass; top-level MIT LICENSE is present and project metadata points to it
checks.json_schema_metaschema: pass when optional jsonschema test extra is installed; skipped otherwise
checks.manifest_member_integrity: pass; regenerated before final packaging and verified with sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256
checks.artifact_audit: pass; strict member audit passes in the clean package
checks.unit_and_e2e_tests: pass; tools/run_acceptance.py is the recipient-facing path; default mode runs the release smoke tests, --all-modules runs the expanded deterministic suite with heavy/E2E/schema gates skipped, and --all enables those explicit opt-in gates.
checks.clean_extract_smoke: pass; final extracted package verified with version, manifest, strict artifact audit, and release smoke before zipping

nonclaims: Acceptance checks do not prove provider identity, context isolation, narrative quality, or empirical efficacy.
Rev0169 is a test-harness, template-gate, and license polish pass; it does not add empirical evidence that retcon planning works.

test_execution.source_tree: pass; bounded item acceptance runner available; smoke, expanded --all-modules, and opt-in --all modes are documented, with --shard N/M for short wall-clock windows
test_execution.default_skip_policy: Default smoke runs artifact, release-surface, and scenario-template guard tests. Expanded --all-modules skips checkpoint/scenario integration, launcher E2E, and optional jsonschema checks unless the matching --heavy, --bundle, --e2e, --schema, or --all flags are used.

commands.developer_discovery: LACUNA_FAST_TEST_IO=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

test_count_scope: default recipient first-contact smoke suite: tests.test_artifact, tests.test_release_surface, tests.test_scenario_template_guard
suite_inventory_note: suites is the expanded unittest method inventory; expanded suites are opt-in through --all-modules, --all, flags, and shards.
